name: Jellyfin
summary: Turns the movies and shows you own into your own Netflix-style app on your TV and phone. Free.
gains: No subscription, no ads, no tracking
Beautiful library with posters and resume
tradeoffs: Only plays content you already own
A computer has to stay on to stream
setupSteps: Install Jellyfin Server on a computer that stays on
Point it at your movies/shows folders
Install the Jellyfin app on your TV and phone
